# shared-chassis

> Cross-cutting library: logging, tracing, security, messaging, outbox, exceptions.

## Docs

- [Overview](wiki/overview.md): Module-by-module architecture, exports, contract tests.

## Source

- Package: `libs/common-python/src/common/`
- Logging: `libs/common-python/src/common/logging.py`
- Tracing: `libs/common-python/src/common/tracing.py`
- Security: `libs/common-python/src/common/security.py`
- Messaging: `libs/common-python/src/common/messaging.py`
- Outbox: `libs/common-python/src/common/database/outbox.py`
- Exceptions: `libs/common-python/src/common/exceptions.py`
